snippet.title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

Play the demo now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4493130/SkiEO_Ski_Resort_Tycoon/
